name: Sense CMS Facebook Publisher
author: QUANT Software House Limited
description: Publishes reviewed Sense CMS posts to a connected Facebook Page through the Meta Graph API.

changelog.summary: Connect and manage multiple Facebook Pages from one or more Meta accounts and publish to each independently.
Present the connected Page, provider status and publishing workflow in the unified Sense CMS workspace design.
Open Meta authorization in a focused popup and report completion in the CMS.
Use native navigation for OAuth connection and disconnect redirects.
Facebook Page OAuth connection, verification and post or photo publishing.
